'''Shakval''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] mechanist living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he was attacked in the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]] and killed by an outsider.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shakval appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an Elite enemy in the Pelath-Ri Marches region on Voss.<ref name="SWTOR" />
